title: M6: Behavioral SRAM controller
description: AXI4 slave, burst-capable, behavioral (no DRAM refresh), backs main memory 0x0000_2000-0x0FFF_FFFF. Execute via: rtl-design-orchestrator for sram_controller.sv RTL; verification-orchestrator for burst read/write + backpressure tests. Deps: M1. See plan M6.

title: M5: DMA engine
description: Descriptor-queue DMA: AXI4 master (burst) + AXI-Lite ctrl slave + IRQ out. Execute via: rtl-design-orchestrator for dma_engine.sv RTL; verification-orchestrator for mem-to-mem copy / IRQ-on-complete / error tests. Deps: M3. See plan M5.

title: M4: Peripherals (UART/SPI/Timer/IRQ ctrl)
description: AXI-Lite peripheral slaves on the M3 control ring (reuse axi_lite_register_bank.sv). Execute via: rtl-design-orchestrator for uart_controller.sv/spi_controller.sv/timer.sv/interrupt_controller.sv RTL; verification-orchestrator for per-peripheral cocotb tests + IRQ-routing checks. Deps: M3. See plan M4.

title: M2: AXI4 burst upgrade of cache refill FSMs
description: Upgrade Phase 3 cache refill FSMs (icache/dcache/arbiter) from 4 sequential AXI4-Lite beats to single AXI4 burst (ARLEN=3). Execute via: rtl-design-orchestrator for rv32i_icache.sv/rv32i_dcache.sv/rv32i_cache_arbiter.sv/rv32i_cache_pkg.sv RTL; verification-orchestrator for burst-aware axi_models.py + full Phase 3 regression (139/139). Deps: M1. See PHASE5_SOC_INTEGRATION_PLAN.md M2.

title: M3: AXI4 crossbar + AXI-Lite interconnect
notes: AXI-Lite half done 2026-05-31: axi_lite_interconnect.sv (1Mx6S router, DECERR) + axi_lite_register_bank.sv (WMASK/wstrb/HW-inject) + soc_periph_map_pkg.sv. Tests 16/16 (regbank 6, interconnect 4, crossbar 6). Lint -Wall clean.
close_reason: M3 complete: crossbar + AXI-Lite control interconnect both delivered, 16/16 SoC tests green, lint clean, docs synced.

title: M1: AXI package + memory-map freeze
design: Execute via: rtl-design-orchestrator (axi_pkg.sv, soc_addr_map_pkg.sv, soc_periph_map_pkg.sv). Lint -Wall via rtl-design-orchestrator. Package+map+reconcile all done 2026-05-31.

title: M8: SoC top integration
description: soc_top.sv: CPU+GPU+DMA+crossbar+AXI-Lite bus+peripherals+SRAM ctrl+IRQ ctrl; clock/reset; IRQ routing; behavioral boot ROM. Execute via: rtl-design-orchestrator for soc_top.sv integration RTL; verification-orchestrator for smoke/connectivity bring-up. Deps: M2-M7. See plan M8.

title: M9: SoC verification
description: CPU->GPU kernel launch->IRQ->result; SW coherency sequence; DMA transfer + peripheral loopback; full CPU+GPU benchmark suite; SoC reference model. Execute via: verification-orchestrator (testbench/regression owner). Deps: M8. See plan M9.

title: M7: Performance counters
description: CSR-mapped (CPU) + AXI-Lite-readable (GPU) counters: cycle, instret, branch mispredicts, I$/D$ miss, active warps, warp-stall, divergence. Execute via: rtl-design-orchestrator for counter RTL + CSR wiring; verification-orchestrator for counter-accuracy tests. Deps: M8 integration (spec early). See plan M7.

title: M12: Sign-off + docs
description: Coverage closure, power analysis, final PPA sign-off, doc sync. Execute via: physical-design-orchestrator for PD sign-off metrics; verification-orchestrator for coverage closure. Deps: M11. See plan M12.

title: M11: Physical design (ASAP7, hierarchical)
description: Full SoC synthesis + P&R + STA on ASAP7 (hierarchical, GPU/CPU macros). phase5_soc.sdc/upf; power-domain validation (PD_CPU/GPU/SRAM/PERIPH). Execute via: physical-design-orchestrator (LibreLane flow owner). Deps: M8/M9. See plan M11.

title: M10: L2 cache decision gate
description: Review L1 miss rates from M9 benchmarks; add rtl/mem/l2_cache.sv only if justified. Execute via: verification-orchestrator for miss-rate analysis; rtl-design-orchestrator for l2_cache.sv RTL if gate passes. Deps: M9 benchmarks. See plan M10.
